start: HQ, a gym page of a gym that used AI column matching in the last 30 days

steps.action: Open the gym from All gyms and scroll to the card AI column matching
user_sees: Box 'Reads a day for this gym' with the hint 'Normal: 20. 0 switches it off for this gym.'
must_not: Another gym's AI use shown
A cost of NaN or a negative number

steps.action: Type 50 into 'Reads a day for this gym' and tap 'Save the limit'
must_not: The limit saved for another gym
A success line when the save failed

steps.action: Reload the gym page
must_not: The box back at the normal number after a reload

start: Gym page of a gym with its own AI limit of 50

steps.action: Tap 'Back to normal'
must_not: The own limit still kept on the server
The box left at 50 after the line says normal

start: Gym page, AI column matching card

steps.action: Type 500 (over the 200 most) and tap 'Save the limit'
user_sees: 'Something in the form is missing or wrong.'
must_not: 500 saved
A success line

steps.action: Open the card while the small Cloudflare database cannot be read
user_sees: 'AI use could not be read right now.'
must_not: AI use shown as none, as if it were true
The whole gym page failing

steps.action: Type 0 and tap 'Save the limit'
must_not: AI matching still running for this gym on its next import

start: Gym page of a gym with no AI use, normal limit

user_sees: 'No AI use in the last 30 days.'

must_not: A cost line of ₹0 for no reads

steps.action: Set 0, save, then tap 'Back to normal'
user_sees: 'Saved: 0 a day.' then 'Back to normal: 20 a day.'
must_not: The gym left switched off after Back to normal

start: Gym page, AI column matching card

steps.action: Read what the card shows
user_sees: Only counts and rupees of AI reads for this gym
must_not: A member name, phone or column contents of the imported file shown in HQ
